answer: Retroactive clawback makes every clone a debt its maker still owes. When the ledger confirms two identities share one paymaster, it recalculates all nectar that cluster ever collected and bills double against future emissions, frozen until the debt clears. Each fake identity therefore costs 6,000 POA on average, and a forty-clone farm that earned 120,000 POA owes 240,000 while earning nothing during repayment, so fresh keys rarely wander onto the mesa of registered names from one purse.
